translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
Alif-Laam-Meem .
Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , jo sada zinda hai , jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ;
uss ney tum per woh kitab nazil ki hai jo haq per mushtamil hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , aur ussi ney toraat aur injeel utaaren .

jo iss say pehlay logon  kay liye mujassam hidayat ban ker aai then , aur ussi ney haq o batil ko parakhney ka mayaar nazil kiya .   . beyshak jinn logon  ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai unn kay liye sakht azab hai , aur Allah zabardast iqtidar ka malik aur burai ka badla denay wala hai .
yaqeen rakho kay Allah say koi cheez chup nahi sakti , naa zameen mein naa aasman mein
wohi hai jo maon kay pet mein jiss tarah chahta hai tumhari soorten banata hai . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh zabardast iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , aalaa darjay ki hikmat ka bhi

. ( aey Rasool ! ) wohi Allah hai jiss ney tum per kitab nazil ki hai jiss ki kuch aayaaten to mohkam hain jinn per kitab ki asal buniyad hai , aur kuch doosri aayaaten mutashabeh hain .   abb jinn logon  kay dilon mein tairrah hai woh inn mutashabeh aayaton kay peechay parray rehtay hain takay fitna peda keren aur inn aayaton ki taweelaat talash keren , halankay inn aayaton ka theek theek matlab Allah kay siwa koi nahi janta , aur jinn logon  ka ilm pukhta hai woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  hum uss ( matlab ) per emaan latay hain ( jo Allah ko maloom hai ) . sabb kuch humaray perwerdigar hi ki taraf say hai .  aur naseehat wohi log hasil kertay hain jo aqal walay hain

. ( aesay log yeh dua kertay hain kay : )  aey humaray rab ! tu ney hamen jo hidayat ata farmaee hai uss kay baad humaray dilon mein tairrah peda naa honey dey , aur khaas apney paas say hamen rehmat ata farma . beyshak teri , aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jo bey inteha bakhshish ki khoogar hai
humaray perwerdigar ! tu tamam insanon ko aik aesay din jama kernay wala hai jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi .  beyshak Allah apney waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , Allah kay muqablay mein naa unn ki dolat unn kay kuch kaam aaye gi , naa unn ki aulad , aur wohi hain jo aag ka endhan ban ker rahen gay .

unn ka haal firon aur unn say pehlay kay logon  kay moamlay jaisa hai . unhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya , chunacheh Allah ney unn ko unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say pakar mein ley liya , aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .
jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn say keh do kay tum maghloob hogay   aur tumhen jama ker kay jahannum ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , aur woh boht bura bichona hai .

tumharay liye unn do girohon ( kay waqaey ) mein bari nishani hai jo aik doosray say takraye thay . unn mein say aik giroh Allah kay raastay mein larr raha tha , aur doosra kafiron ka giroh tha jo apney aap ko khuli aankhon unn say kaee guna ziyada dekh raha tha .   aur Allah jiss ki chahta hai apni madad say taeed kerta hai . beyshak uss waqaey mein aankhon walon kay liye ibrat ka bara saman hai .

logon  kay liye unn cheezon ki mohabbat khushnuma bana di gaee hai jo unn ki nafsani khuwaish kay mutabiq hoti hai , yani aurten , bacchay , soney chaandi kay lagay huye dher , nishan lagaye huye ghorray , chopaye aur khetiyan . yeh sabb dunyawi zindagi ka saman hai ( lekin ) abadi anjam ka hussn to sirf Allah kay paas hai .

keh do ! kiya mein tumhen woh cheezen bataon jo inn sabb say kahen behtar hain-? jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain unn kay liye unn kay rab kay paas woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur pakeezah biwiyan hain , aur Allah ki taraf say khushnoodi hai . aur tamam bandon ko Allah achi tarah dekh raha hai .
yeh woh log hain jo kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum aap per emaan ley aaye hain . abb humaray gunahon ko bakhsh dijiye , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha lijiye .

yeh log baray sabar kernay walay hain , sachai kay khoogar hain , ibadat guzaar hain , ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kharch kernay walay hain , aur sehri kay oqaat mein astaghfaar kertay rehtay hain .

Allah ney khud iss baat ki gawahi di hai , aur farishton aur ehal-e-ilm ney bhi , kay uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jiss ney insaf kay sath ( kainat ) ka intizam sanbhala huwa hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

beyshak ( moatabir ) deen to Allah kay nazdeek Islam hi hai . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi unhon ney alag raasta laa-ilmi mein nahi balkay ilm aajaney kay baad mehaz aapas ki zidd ki wajeh say ikhtiyar kiya aur , jo shaks bhi Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye to ( ussay yaad rakhna chahiye kay ) Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai

phir bhi agar yeh tum say jhagrren to keh do kay :  mein ney to apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerliya hai , aur jinhon ney meri ittaba ki hai unhon ney bhi .  aur ehal-e-kitab say aur ( arab kay ) ann parh ( mushrikeen ) say keh do kay kiya tum bhi Islam latay ho-? phir agar woh Islam ley ayen to hidayat paajayen gay , aur agar unhon ney mun morra to tumhari zimma daari sirf paygham phonchanay ki hadd tak hai , aur Allah tamam bandon ko khud dekh raha hai .
jo log Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlatay hain aur nabiyon ko nahaq qatal kertay hain , aur insaf ki talqeen kernay walay logon  ko bhi qatal kertay hain , unn ko dardnak azab ki   khushkhabri " suna do .
yeh woh log hain jinn kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat mein gharat ho chukay hain , aur inn ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar naseeb nahi hon gay .

kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhen kitab ka aik hissa diya gaya tha kay unhen Allah ki kitab ki taraf dawat di jati hai takay woh unn kay darmiyan faisla keray , iss kay bawajood unn mein say aik giroh mun morr ker inehraaf ker-jata hai .

yeh sabb iss liye hai kay unhon ney yeh kaha huwa hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay siwa aag hergiz nahi chooay gi . aur unhon ney jo jhooti baaten tarash rakhi hain unhon ney unn kay deen kay moamlay mein unn ko dhokay mein daal diya hai

bhala uss waqt unn ka kiya haal hoga jab hum unhen aik aesay din ( ka samna kernay ) kay liye jama ker layen gay jiss kay aaney mein zara bhi shak nahi hai , aur her her shaks ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi woh uss ko poori poori dey di jaye gi , aur kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga .

kaho kay :  aey Allah ! aey iqtidar kay malik ! to jiss ko chahta hai iqtidar bakhshta hai , aur jiss say chahta hai iqtidar cheen leta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai izzat bakhshta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai ruswa ker deta hai , tamam tarr bhalai teray hi haath mein hai . yaqeenan tu her cheez per qadir hai .

tu hi raat ko din mein dakhil kerta hai aur din ko raat mein dakhil kerta hai .   aur tu hi bey jaan cheez mein say jandaar ko bar-aamad kerleta hai aur jandaar mein say bey jaan cheez nikal lata hai ,   aur jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq ata farmata hai .

momin log musalmanon ko chorr ker kafiron ko apna yaar-o-madadgaar naa banayen . aur jo aisa keray ga uss ka Allah say koi talluq nahi , illa yeh kay tum unn ( kay zulm ) say bachney kay liye bachao ka koi tareeqa ikhtiyar kero .   aur Allah tumhen apney ( azab ) say bachata hai . aur ussi ki taraf ( sabb ko ) loat ker jana hai .

. ( aey Rasool ! ) logon  ko bata do kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai tum ussay chupao ya zahir kero , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , woh sabb janta hai , aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

woh din yaad rakho jiss din kissi bhi shaks ney naiki ka jo kaam kiya hoga ussay apney samney mojood paye ga , aur burai ka jo kaam kiya hoga uss ko bhi ( apney samney dekh ker ) yeh tamanna keray ga kay kaash uss kay aur uss ki badi kay darmiyan boht door ka fasla hota ! aur Allah tumhen apney ( azab ) say bachata hai , aur Allah bandon per boht shafqat rakhta hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay agar tum Allah say mohabbat rakhtay ho to meri ittaba kero , Allah tum say mohabbat keray ga aur tumhari khatir tumharay gunah moaaf kerday ga . aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai .
keh do kay Allah aur Rasool ki itaat kero . phir bhi agar mun morro gay to Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .
Allah ney Adam , nooh , Ibrahim kay khandan , aur imran kay khandan ko chunn ker tamam jahano per fazilat di thi .
yeh aesi nasal thi jiss kay afrad ( naiki aur ikhlas mein ) aik doosray say miltay jultay thay .   aur Allah ( her aik ki baat ) sunney wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .

. ( chunacheh Allah kay dua sunney ka woh waqiaa yaad kero ) jab imran ki biwi ney kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! mein ney nazar maani hai kay meray pet mein jo baccha hai mein ussay her kaam say azad ker kay teray liye waqf rakhun gi . meri iss nazar ko qubool farma . beyshak tu sunney wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .

phir jab unn say larki peda hoi to woh ( hasrat say ) kehney lagen :  ya rab ! yeh to mujh say larki peda hogaee hai .  halankay Allah ko khoob ilm tha kay unn kay yahan kiya peda huwa hai .  aur larka larki jaisa nahi hota . mein ney uss ka naam maryam rakh diya hai aur mein ussay aur uss ki aulad ko shetan mardood say hifazat kay liye aap ki panah mein deti hun .

chunacheh uss kay rab ney uss ( maryam ) ko ba-tareeq ahsan qubool kiya aur ussay behtareen tareeqay say perwan charrhaya . aur zakriya uss kay sarparast banay .   jab bhi zakriya unn kay paas unn ki ibadat gaah mein jatay , unn kay paas koi rizq paatay . unhon ney poocha :  maryam ! tumharay paas yeh cheezen kahan say ayen-?  woh bolen :  Allah kay paas say ! Allah jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq deta hai .
iss moaqa per zakriya ney apney rab say dua ki , kehney lagay :  ya rab ! mujhay khaas apney paas say pakeezah aulad ata farmadey . beyshak tu dua ka sunney wala hai .

chunacheh ( aik din ) jab zakriya ibadat gaah mein kharray namaz parh rahey thay , farishton ney unhen aawaz di kay :  Allah aap ko Yahya ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri deta hai jo iss shaan say peda hon gay kay Allah kay aik kalmay ki tasdeeq keren gay ,   logon  kay peshwa hon gay , apney aap ko nafsani khuwaishaat say mukammal tor per rokay huye hon gay ,   aur nabi hon gay aur unn ka shumar raast bazon mein hoga .
zakriya ney kaha :  ya rab ! meray yahan larka kiss tarah peda hoga jabkay mujhay burhapa aa-phoncha hai aur meri biwi baanjh hai ?    Allah ney kaha :  issi tarah ! Allah jo chahta hai kerta hai .

unhon ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! meray liye koi nishani muqarrar ker-dijiye . Allah ney kaha :  tumhari nishani yeh hogi kay tum teen din tak isharon kay siwa koi baat nahi ker-sako gay .   aur apney rab ka kasrat say ziker kertay raho , aur dhalay din kay waqt bhi aur subha saweray bhi Allah ki tasbeeh kiya kero .

aur ( abb uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab farishton ney kaha tha kay :  aey maryam ! beyshak Allah ney tumhen chunn liya hai , tumhen pakeezgi ata ki hai aur duniya jahan ki sari aurton mein tumhen muntakhib kerkay fazilat bakhshi hai .
aey maryam ! tum apney rab ki ibadat mein lagi raho , aur sajda kero aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo bhi kiya kero .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh sabb ghaib ki khabren hain jo hum wahi kay zariye tumhen dey rahey hain . tum uss waqt unn kay paas nahi thay jab woh yeh tey kernay kay liye apney qalam daal rahey thay kay unn mein say kon maryam ki kafalat keray ga ,   aur naa uss waqt tum unn kay paas thay jab woh ( iss maslay mein ) aik doosray say ikhtilaf ker-rahey thay .

. ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab farishton ney maryam say kaha tha kay :  aey maryam ! Allah taalaa tumhen apney aik kalmay ki ( pedaeesh ) ki khushkhabri deta hai jiss ka naam maseeh essa ibn-e-maryam hoga ,   jo duniya aur aakhirat dono mein sahab-e-wajahat hoga , aur ( Allah kay ) muqarrab bandon mein say hoga .
aur woh gehwaray mein bhi logon  say baat keray ga   aur bari umar mein bhi , aur raast baaz logon  mein say hoga .

maryam ney kaha :  perwerdigar ! mujh say larka kaisay peda hojaye ga jabkay mujhay kissi bashar ney chooa tak nahi-?  Allah ney farmaya :  Allah issi tarah jiss ko chahta hai peda kerta hai . jab woh koi kaam kernay ka faisla kerleta hai to sirf itna kehta hai kay   hoja " bus woh hojata hai .
aur wohi ( Allah ) uss ko ( yani essa ibn-e-maryam ko ) kitab o hikmat aur toraat o injeel ki taleem dey ga .

aur ussay bani Israel kay paas Rasool bana ker bhejay ga ( jo logon  say yeh kahey ga ) kay :  mein tumharay paas tumharay rab ki taraf say aik nishani ley ker aaya hun , ( aur woh nishani yeh hai ) kay mein tumharay samney garay say perinday jaisi aik shakal banata hun , phir uss mein phoonk maarta hun , to woh Allah kay hukum say perinda ban jata hai , aur mein Allah kay hukum say madarzaad andhay aur korhi ko tandurust ker deta hun , aur murdon ko zinda ker deta hun , aur tum log jo kuch apney gharon mein khatay ya zakheera ker kay rakhtay ho mein woh sabb bata deta hun .   agar tum emaan laney walay ho to inn tamam baaton mein tumharay liye ( kafi ) nishani hai .

aur jo kitab mujh say pehlay aa-chuki hai , yani toraat , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur ( iss liye bheja gaya hun ) takay kuch cheezen jo tum per haram ki gaee then , abb tumharay liye halal kerdun .   aur mein tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaya hun , lehaza Allah say daro aur mera kehna maano .
beyshak Allah mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . yehi seedha raasta hai ( kay sirf ussi ki ibadat kero )

phir jab essa ney mehsoos kiya kay woh kufr per aamada hain , to unhon ney ( apney pairo-on say ) kaha :  kon kon log hain jo Allah ki raah mein meray madadgaar hon-?  hawariyon   ney kaha :  hum Allah ( kay deen ) kay madadgaar hain , hum Allah per emaan laa-chukay hain , aur aap gawah rahiye kay hum farmanbardaar hain .
aey humaray rab ! aap ney jo kuch nazil kiya hai hum uss per emaan laye hain aur hum ney Rasool ki ittaba ki hai , lehaza hamen unn logon  mein likh lijiye jo ( haq ki ) gawahi denay walay hain .
aur unn kafiron ney ( essa ( aleh-assalam ) kay khilaf ) khufiya tadbeer ki , aur Allah ney bhi khufiya tadbeer ki . aur Allah sabb say behtar tadbeer kernay wala hai .

. ( uss ki tadbeer uss waqt samney aai ) jab Allah ney kaha tha kay :  aey essa ! mein tumhen sahih saalim wapis ley lun ga ,   aur tumhen apni taraf utha lun ga , aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn ( ki eeza ) say tumhen pak kerdun ga . aur jinn logon  ney tumhari ittaba ki hai , unn ko qayamat kay din tak unn logon  per ghalib rakhun ga jinhon ney tumhara inkar kiya hai .   phir tum sabb ko meray paas loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumharay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla kerun ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kertay thay .
chunacheh jo log aesay hain kay unhon ney kufr apna liya hai , unn ko to mein duniya aur aakhirat mein sakht azab dun ga , aur unn ko kissi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .
albatta jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko Allah unn ka poora poora sawab dey ga , aur Allah zalimon ko pasand nahi kerta .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh woh aayaten aur hikmat bhara ziker hai jo hum tumhen parh ker suna rahey hain .
Allah kay nazdeek essa ki misal Adam jaisi hai ; Allah ney unhen mitti say peda kiya , phir unn say kaha :  hojao  bus woh hogaye
haq wohi hai jo tumharay rab ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein shamil naa hojana .

tumharay paas ( hazrat essa ( aleh-assalam ) kay waqaey ka ) jo sahih ilm aagaya hai uss kay baad bhi jo log iss moamlay mein tum say behas keren to unn say keh do kay :   aao hum apney beton ko bulayen aur tum apney beton ko , aur hum apni aurton ko aur tum apni aurton ko , aur hum apney logon  ko aur tum apney logon  ko , phir hum sabb milker Allah kay samney girr-girrayen , aur jo jhootay hon unn per Allah ki lanat bhejen .
yaqeen jano kay waqiyaat ka sacha biyan yehi hai . aur Allah kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . aur yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to Allah mufsidon ko achi tarah janta hai .

. ( musalmano ! yahood o nasara say ) keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! aik aesi baat ki taraf aajao jo hum tum mein mushtariq ho , ( aur woh yeh ) kay hum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa keren , aur uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrayen , aur Allah ko chorr ker hum aik doosray ko rab naa banayen .  phir bhi agar woh mun morren to keh do :  gawah rehna kay hum musalman hain .
aey ehal-e-kitab ! tum Ibrahim kay baaray mein kiyon behas kertay ho halankay toraat aur injeel unn kay baad hi to nazil hoi then ; kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi hai ?

dekho ! yeh tum hi to ho jinhon ney unn moamlaat mein apni si behas kerli hai jinn ka tumhen kuch naa kuch ilm tha .   abb unn moamlaat mein kiyon behas kertay ho jinn ka tumhen siray say koi ilm hi nahi hai ? Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .
Ibrahim naa yahudi thay , naa nasrani , balkay woh to seedhay seedhay musalman thay , aur shirk kernay walon mein kabhi shamil nahi huye .

Ibrahim kay sath talluq kay sabb say ziyada haq daar woh log hain jinhon ney unn ki perwi ki , neez yeh nabi ( aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) aur woh log hain jo ( unn per ) emaan laye hain , aur Allah mominon ka kaarsaz hai .
. ( musalmano ! ) ehal-e-kitab ka aik giroh yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko gumrah kerday , halankay woh apney siwa kissi aur ko gumrah nahi ker rahey , agar-cheh unhen uss ka ehsas nahi hai
aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kiyon inkar kertay ho halankay tum khud ( unn kay min-janib Allah honey kay ) gawah ho ?
aey ehal-e-kitab ! tum haq ko batil kay sath kiyon gaddmadd kertay ho aur kiyon jaan boojh ker haq baat ko chupatay ho-?

ehal-e-kitab kay aik giroh ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha hai kay :  jo kalam musalmanon per nazil kiya gaya hai , uss per din kay shuroo mein to emaan ley aao , aur din kay aakhri hissay mein uss say inkar ker-dena , shayad iss tarah musalman ( bhi apney deen say ) phir jayen .

magar dil say unn logon  kay siwa kissi ki naa manna jo tumharay deen kay muttabey hain .  aap unn say keh dijiye kay hidayat to wohi hidayat hai jo Allah ki di hoi ho . yeh sari baaten tum uss zidd mein ker rahey ho kay kissi ko uss jaisi cheez ( yani nabwooat aur aasmani kitab ) kiyon mil gaee jaisi kabhi tumhen di gaee thi ya yeh ( musalman ) tumharay rab kay aagay tum per ghalib kiyon aagaye !  aap keh dijiye kay fazilat tamam tarr Allah kay haath mein hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai dey deta hai , aur Allah bari wusat wala hai , her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai .
woh apni rehmat kay liye jiss ko chahta hai khaas tor per muntakhib kerleta hai , aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

ehal-e-kitab mein kuch log to aesay hain kay agar tum unn kay paas dolat ka aik dher bhi amanat kay tor per rakhwa do to woh tumhen wapis kerden gay , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain kay agar aik deenar ki amanat bhi unn kay paas rakhwao to woh tumhen wapis nahi den gay , illa yeh kay tum unn kay sar per kharray raho . unn ka yeh tarz-e-amal iss liye hai kay unhon ney yeh keh rakha hai kay :  ummyon ( yani ghair yahudi arbon ) kay sath moamla kernay mein humari koi pakar nahi hogi .  aur ( iss tarah ) woh Allah per jaan boojh ker jhoot baandhtay hain .
bhala pakar kiyon nahi hogi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo apney ehad ko poora keray ga aur gunah say bacchay ga to Allah aesay perhezgaron say mohabbat kerta hai .

. ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad aur apni khai hoi qasmon ka soda ker kay thori si qeemat hasil kerletay hain unn ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga , aur qayamat kay din naa Allah unn say baat keray ga , naa unhen ( riyat ki nazar say ) dekhay ga , naa unhen pak keray ga , aur unn ka hissa to bus azab hoga , intehai dardnak !

aur unhi mein say aik giroh kay log aesay hain jo kitab ( yani toraat ) parhtay waqt apni zabanon ko marortay hain takay tum ( unn ki maror ker banai hoi ) uss ibarat ko kitab ka hissa samjho , halankay woh kitab ka hissa nahi hoti . aur woh kehtay hain kay yeh ( ibarat ) Allah ki taraf say hai , halankay woh Allah ki taraf say nahi hoti . aur ( iss tarah ) woh Allah per jantay boojhtay jhoot baandhtay hain .

yeh kissi bashar ka kaam nahi kay Allah to ussay kitab aur hikmat aur nabwooat ata keray , aur woh uss kay bawajood logon  say kahey kay Allah ko chorr ker meray banday ban jao .   iss kay bajaye ( woh to yehi kahey ga kay ) Allah walay ban jao , kiyonkay tum jo kitab parhatay rahey ho aur jo kuch parhtay rahey ho , uss ka yehi nateeja hona chahiye .
aur naa woh tumhen yeh hukum dey sakta hai kay farishton aur payghumberon ko khuda qarar dey do . jab tum musalman ho chukay to kiya uss kay baad woh tumhen kufr ikhtiyar kernay ka hukum dey ga-?

aur ( inn ko woh waqt yaad dilao ) jab Allah ney payghumberon say ehad liya tha kay :  agar mein tum ko kitab aur hikmat ata kerun , phir tumharay paas koi Rasool aaye jo uss ( kitab ) ki tasdeeq keray jo tumharay paas hai , to tum uss per zaroor emaan lao gay , aur zaroor uss ki madad kero gay .  Allah ney ( unn payghumberon say ) kaha tha kay :  kiya tum iss baat ka iqrar kertay ho aur meri taraf say di hoi yeh zimma daari uthatay ho-?  unhon ney kaha tha :  hum iqrar kertay hain .  Allah ney kaha :  to phir ( aik doosray kay iqrar kay ) gawah ban jao , aur mein bhi tumharay sath gawahi mein shamil hun .
iss kay baad bhi jo log ( hidayat say ) mun morren gay to aesay log nafarman hon gay .

abb kiya yeh log Allah kay deen kay ilawa kissi aur deen ki talash mein hain-? halankay aasmano aur zameen mein jitni makhlooqaat hain unn sabb ney Allah hi kay aagay gardan jhuka rakhi hai , ( kuch ney ) khushi say aur ( kuch ney ) nachaar hoker ,   aur ussi ki taraf woh sabb loat ker jayen gay .

keh do kay :  hum emaan laye Allah per aur jo ( kitab ) hum per utaari gaee uss per , aur uss ( hidayat ) per jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur ( unn ki ) aulad per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaari gaee , aur unn baaton per jo musa , essa aur ( doosray ) payghumberon ko ata ki gaeen . hum unn ( payghumberon ) mein say kissi kay darmiyan koi farq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik Allah ) kay aagay sar jhukaye huye hain .

jo koi shaks Islam kay siwa koi aur deen ikhtiyar kerna chahye ga , to uss say woh deen qubool nahi kiya jaye ga , aur aakhirat mein woh unn logon  mein shamil hoga jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

Allah aesay logon  ko kaisay hidayat dey jinhon ney emaan laney kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kerliya-? halankay woh gawahi dey chukay thay kay yeh Rasool sachay hain , aur unn kay paas ( uss kay ) roshan dalaeel bhi aa-chukay thay . Allah aesay zalimon ko hidayat nahi diya kerta .
aesay logon  ki saza yeh hai kay unn per Allah ki , farishton ki , aur tamam insanon ki phitkaar hai .
issi ( phitkaar ) mein yeh hamesha rahen gay , naa inn kay liye azab halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa enhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .
albatta jo log iss sabb kay baad bhi tauba ker kay apni islaah kerlen , to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

. ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jinn logon  ney emaan laney kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kiya , phir kufr mein barhtay hi chalay gaye , unn ki tauba hergiz qubool naa hogi ,   aesay log raastay say bilkul hi bhatak chukay hain .

jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn mein say kissi say poori zameen bhar ker sona bhi qubool nahi kiya jaye ga , khuwa woh apni jaan churraney kay liye uss ki paishkash hi kiyon naa keray . unn ko to dardnak azab ho ker rahey ga , aur unn ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

tum naiki kay maqam tak uss waqt tak hergiz nahi phoncho gay jab tak unn cheezon mein say ( Allah kay liye ) kharch naa kero jo tumhen mehboob hain .   aur jo kuch bhi tum kharch kero , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

toraat kay nazil honey say pehlay khaney ki tamam cheezen ( jo musalmanon kay liye halal hain ) bani Israel kay liye ( bhi ) halal then , siwaye uss cheez kay jo Israel ( yani Yaqoob aleh-assalam ) ney apney oopper haram kerli thi . ( aey payghumber ! yahudiyon say ) keh do kay :  agar tum sachay ho to toraat ley ker aao aur uss ki tilawat kero .
phir inn baaton kay ( wazeh honey kay ) baad bhi jo log Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhen , to aesay log baray zalim hain .

aap kahiye kay Allah ney sach kaha hai , lehaza tum Ibrahim kay deen ka ittaba kero jo poori tarah seedhay raastay per thay , aur unn logon  mein say nahi thay jo Allah ki khudai mein kissi ko shareek mantay hain .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay sabb say pehla ghar jo logon  ( ki ibadat ) kay liye banaya gaya yaqeeni tor per woh hai jo makkah mein waqay hai ( aur ) bananey kay waqt hi say barkaton wala aur duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye hidayat ka saman hai .

uss mein roshan nishaniyan hain , maqam-e-Ibrahim hai , aur jo uss mein dakhil hota hai aman paajata hai . aur logon  mein say jo log uss tak phonchney ki istataat rakhtay hon unn per Allah kay liye uss ghar ka hajj kerna farz hai , aur agar koi inkar keray to Allah duniya jahan kay tamam logon  say bey niaz hai .
keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kiyon inkar kertay ho-? jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss sabb ka gawah hai .

keh do kay :  aey ehal-e-kitab ! Allah kay raastay mein tairrah peda kernay ki koshish ker kay aik momin kay liye uss mein kiyon rukawat daaltay ho jabkay tum khud haqeeqat-e-haal kay gawah ho-?   jo kuch tum ker rahey ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .
aey emaan walo ! agar tum ehal-e-kitab kay aik giroh ki baat maan lo gay to woh tumharay emaan laney kay baad tum ko dobara kafir bana ker choren gay .

aur tum kaisay kufr apnao gay jabkay Allah ki aayaten tumharay samney tilawat ki jati hain aur uss ka Rasool tumharay darmiyan mojood hai-? aur ( Allah ki sunnat yeh hai kay ) jo shaks Allah ka sahara mazbooti say thaam ley , woh seedhay raastay tak phoncha diya jata hai .
aey emaan walo ! dil mein Allah ka wesa hi khof rakho jaisa khof rakhna uss ka haq hai , aur khabrdar ! tumhen kissi aur halat mein moat naa aaye , balkay issi halat mein aaye kay tum musalman ho .

aur Allah ki rassi ko sabb milker mazbooti say thamay rakho , aur aapas mein phoot naa daalo , aur Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai ussay yaad rakho kay aik waqt tha jab tum aik doosray kay dushman thay , phir Allah ney tumharay dilon ko jorr diya aur tum Allah kay fazal say bhai bhai ban gaye , aur tum aag kay garrhey kay kinaray per thay , Allah ney tumhen uss say nijat ata farmaee . issi tarah Allah tumharay liye apni nishaniyan khol khol ker wazeh kerta hai , takay tum raah-e-raast per aajao .
aur tumharay darmiyan aik jamat aesi honi chahiye jiss kay afrad ( logon  ko ) bhalai ki taraf bulayen , naiki ki talqeen keren , aur burai say roken . aesay hi log hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

aur unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jinn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel aa-chukay thay , uss kay baad bhi unhon ney aapas mein phoot daal li aur ikhtilaf mein parr-gaye . aesay logon  ko sakht saza hogi .

uss din jab kuch chehray chamaktay hon gay aur kuch chehray siyah parr-jayen gay ! chunacheh jinn logon  kay chehray siyah parr-jayen gay unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  kiya tum ney apney emaan kay baad kufr ikhtiyar kerliya-?   lo phir abb maza chakho iss azab ka , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .
doosri taraf jinn logon  kay chehray chamaktay hon gay woh Allah ki rehmat mein jagah payen gay . woh ussi mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain , aur Allah duniya jahan kay logon  per kissi tarah ka zulm kerna nahi chahta
aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , Allah hi ka hai aur ussi ki taraf tamam moamlaat lotaye jayen gay .

. ( musalmano ! ) tum woh behtareen ummat ho jo logon  kay faeeday kay liye wajood mein laee gaee hai . tum naiki ki talqeen kertay ho , burai say roktay ho aur Allah per emaan rakhtay ho . agar ehal-e-kitab emaan ley aatay to yeh unn kay haq mein kahen behtar hota . unn mein say kuch to momin hain , magar unn ki aksariyat nafarman hai .
woh thora boht sataney kay siwa tumhen koi bara nuqsan hergiz nahi phoncha saken gay . aur agar woh tum say larren gay bhi to tumhen peeth dikha jayen gay , phir unhen koi madad bhi nahi phonchay gi

woh jahan kahen paye jayen , unn per zillat ka thappa laga diya gaya hai , illa yeh kay Allah ki taraf say koi sabab peda hojaye ya insanon ki taraf say koi zariya nikal aaye jo unn ko sahara deydey ; anjam kaar woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay hain , aur unn per mohtaji musallat kerdi gaee hai . iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal kertay thay . ( neez ) iss ki wajeh yeh hai kay woh nafarmani kertay thay , aur sari haden phalang jaya kertay thay

. ( lekin ) saray ehal-e-kitab aik jaisay nahi hain . ehal-e-kitab hi mein woh log bhi hain jo ( raah-e-raast per ) qaeem hain , jo raat kay oqaat mein Allah ki aayaton ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jo ( Allah kay aagay ) sajda rez hotay hain

yeh log Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , achai ki talqeen kertay aur burai say roktay hain , aur naik kamon ki taraf lapaktay hain . yeh woh log hain jinn ka shumar sualeheen mein hai .
woh jo bhalai bhi keren gay , uss ki hergiz na-qadri nahi ki jaye gi , aur Allah perhezgaron ko khoob janta hai .
. ( iss kay bar-aks ) jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , Allah kay muqablay mein naa unn kay maal unn kay kuch kaam ayen gay , naa aulad . woh dozakhi log hain ; ussi mein woh hamesha rahen gay

jo kuch yeh log dunyawi zindagi mein kharch kertay hain , uss ki misal aesi hai jaisay aik sakht sardi wali tez huwa ho jo unn logon  ki kheti ko jaa lagay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm ker rakha ho , aur woh iss kheti ko barbad kerday .   unn per Allah ney zulm nahi kiya , balkay woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey hain .

aey emaan walo ! apney say bahir kay kissi shaks ko raz daar naa banao , yeh log tumhari bad-khuwahi mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhtay .   unn ki dili khuwaish yeh hai kay tum takleef uthao . bughz unn kay mun say zahir hochuka hai , aur jo kuch ( adawat ) unn kay seenay chupaye huye hain woh kahen ziyada hai . hum ney pattay ki baaten tumhen khol khol ker bata di hain , ba-shartey-kay tum samajh say kaam lo .

dekho ! tum to aesay ho kay unn say mohabbat rakhtay ho , magar woh tum say mohabbat nahi rakhtay , aur tum to tamam ( aasmani ) kitabon per emaan rakhtay ho , aur ( unn ka haal yeh hai kay ) woh jab tum say miltay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ( Quran per ) emaan ley aaye , aur jab tanhai mein jatay hain to tumharay khilaf ghussay kay maaray apni ungliyan chabatay hain . ( unn say ) keh do kay  apney ghussay mein khud mar raho . Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaten khoob janta hai .

agar tumhen koi bhalai mil jaye to unn ko bura lagta hai , aur agar tumhen koi gazand phonchay to yeh uss say khush hotay hain . agar tum sabar aur taqwa say kaam lo to unn ki chaalen tumhen koi nuqsan nahi phonchayen gi . jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain woh sabb Allah kay ( ilm aur qudrat kay ) ehatay mein hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! Jang-e-ohad ka woh waqt yaad kero ) jab tum subha kay waqt apney ghar say nikal ker musalmanon ko jang kay thikanon per jama rahey thay ,   aur Allah sabb kuch sunney janney wala hai
jab tumhi mein kay do girohon ney yeh socha tha kay woh himmat haar bethen ,   halankay Allah unn ka haami o nasir tha , aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

Allah ney to ( jang ) badar kay moaqa per aesi halat mein tumhari madad ki thi jab tum bilkul bey sar-o-saman thay .   lehaza ( sirf ) Allah ka khof dil mein rakho , takay tum shukar guzaar ban sako .
jab ( badar ki jang mein ) tum mominon say keh rahey thay kay :  kiya tumharay liye yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay tumhara perwerdigar teen hazar farishtay utaar ker tumhari madad ko bhej dey ?

haan ! balkay agar tum sabar aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero aur woh log apney ussi relay mein achanak tum tak phonch jayen to tumhara perwerdigar paanch hazar farishtay tumhari madad ko bhej dey ga jinhon ney apni pehchan numaya ki hoi hogi .

Allah ney yeh intizam sirf iss liye kiya tha takay tumhen khushkhabri milay , aur uss say tumharay dilon ko itminan naseeb ho , werna fatah to kissi aur ki taraf say nahi , sirf Allah kay paas say aati hai jo mukammal iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , tamam tarr hikmat ka bhi malik .

. ( aur jang-e-badar mein yeh madad Allah ney iss liye ki ) takay jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai unn ka aik hissa kaat ker rakh dey , ya unn ko aesi zillat aamez shikast dey kay woh na-murad ho ker wapis chalay jayen .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhen iss faislay ka koi ikhtiyar nahi kay Allah unn ki tauba qubool keray ya unn ko azab dey kiyonkay yeh zalim log hain .
aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . woh jiss ko chahta hai moaaf ker deta hai aur jiss ko chahta hai azab deta hai , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .
aey emaan walo ! kaee guna barha charha ker sood matt khao , aur Allah say daro , takay tumhen falah hasil ho
aur uss aag say daro jo kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai .
aur Allah aur Rasool ki baat maano , takay tum say rehmat ka bartao kiya jaye .

aur apney rab ki taraf say maghfirat aur woh jannat hasil kernay kay liye aik doosray say barh ker tezi dikhao jiss ki chorai itni hai kay uss mein tamam aasman aur zameen samaa jayen . woh unn perhezgaron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai

jo khushhali mein bhi aur bad-haali mein bhi ( Allah kay liye ) maal kharch kertay hain , aur jo ghussay ko pi janey aur logon  ko moaaf ker-denay kay aadi hain . Allah aesay naik logon  say mohabbat kerta hai .

aur yeh woh log hain kay agar kabhi koi bey hayai ka kaam ker bhi bethtay hain ya ( kissi aur tarah ) apni jaan per zulm ker guzartay hain to foran Allah ko yaad kertay hain aur uss kay nateejay mein apney gunahon ki moaafi maangtay hain aur Allah kay siwa hai bhi kon jo gunahon ki moaafi dey-? aur yeh apney kiye per jantay boojhtay israr nahi kertay

yeh hain woh log jinn ka sila unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say maghfirat hai , aur woh baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay darya behtay hon gay , jinn mein unhen daemi zindagi hasil hogi . kitna behtareen badla hai jo kaam kernay walon ko milna hai !
tum say pehlay boht say waqiyaat guzar chukay hain . abb tum zameen mein chal phir ker dekh lo kay jinhon ney ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha unn ka anjam kaisa huwa-?
yeh tamam logon  kay liye wazeh aelaan hai aur perhezgaron kay liye hidayat aur naseehat !
. ( musalmano ! ) tum naa to kamzor parro , aur naa ghumgeen raho . agar tum waqaee momin raho to tum hi sarbuland hogay .

agar tumhen aik zakham laga hai to inn logon  ko bhi ussi jaisa zakham pehlay lagg chuka hai .   yeh to aatay jatay din hain jinhen hum logon  kay darmiyan baari baari badaltay rehtay hain , aur maqsad yeh tha kay Allah emaan walon ko janch ley , aur tum mein say kuch logon  ko shaheed qarar dey , aur Allah zalimon ko pasand nahi kerta
aur maqsad yeh ( bhi ) tha kay Allah emaan walon ko mail kuchail say nikhar ker rakh dey aur kafiron ko malya mait ker daalay .

bhala kiya tum yeh samajhtay ho kay ( yunhi ) jannat kay andar ja-phoncho gay-? halankay abhi tak Allah ney tum mein say unn logon  ko janch ker nahi dekha jo jihad keren , aur naa unn ko janch ker dekha hai jo sabit qadam rehney walay hain .
aur tum to khud moat ka samna kernay say pehlay ( shahadat ki ) moat ki tamanna kiya kertay thay .   chunacheh abb tum ney khuli aankhon ussay dekh liya hai .

aur Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) aik Rasool hi to hain ; inn say pehlay boht say Rasool guzar chukay hain . bhala agar inn ka intiqal hojaye ya enhen qatal kerdiya jaye to kiya tum ultay paon phir jao gay-? aur jo koi ultay paon phiray ga woh Allah ko hergiz koi nuqsan nahi phoncha sakta . aur jo shukar guzaar banday hain Allah unn ko sawab dey ga .

aur yeh kissi bhi shaks kay ikhtiyar mein nahi hai kay ussay Allah kay hukum kay baghair moat aajaye , jiss ka aik moyyan waqt per aana likha huwa hai . aur jo shaks duniya ka badla chahye ga hum ussay uss ka hissa dey den gay , aur jo aakhirat ka sawab chahye ga hum ussay uss ka hissa ata kerden gay ,   aur jo log shukar guzaar hain unn ko hum jald hi unn ka ajar ata keren gay .

aur kitney saray payghumber hain jinn kay sath milker boht say Allah walon ney jang ki ! nateeja unhen Allah kay raastay mein jo takleefen phonchen unn ki wajeh say naa unhon ney himmat haari , naa woh kamzor parray aur naa unhon ney apney aap ko jhukaya . Allah aesay sabit qadam logon  say mohabbat kerta hai .

unn kay mun say jo baat nikli woh iss kay siwa nahi thi kay woh keh rahey thay :  humaray perwerdigar ! humaray gunahon ko bhi aur hum say apney kamon mein jo ziyadti hoi ho uss ko bhi moaaf farmadey , hamen sabit qadmi bakhsh dey , aur kafir logon  kay muqablay mein hamen fatah ata farmadey .
chunacheh Allah ney unhen duniya ka inaam bhi diya aur aakhirat ka behtareen sawab bhi . aur Allah aesay naik logon  say mohabbat kerta hai .
aey emaan walo ! jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai agar tum unn ki baat maano gay to woh tumhen ultay paon ( kufr ki taraf ) loata den gay , aur tum palat ker sakht nuqsan uthao gay .
. ( yeh log tumharay khair khuwa nahi ) balkay Allah tumhara haami o nasir hai , aur woh behtareen madadgaar hai .

jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai , hum unqareeb unn kay dilon mein roab daal den gay kiyonkay unhon ney Allah ki khudai mein aesi cheezon ko shareek thehraya hai jinn kay baaray mein Allah ney koi daleel nahi utaari . unn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh zalimon ka bad-tareen thikana hai .

aur Allah ney yaqeenan uss waqt apna wada poora kerdiya tha jab tum dushmanon ko ussi kay hukum say qatal ker rahey thay , yahan tak kay jab tum ney kamzori dikhai aur hukum kay baaray mein baham ikhtilaf kiya aur jab Allah ney tumhari pasandeeda cheez tumhen dikhai to tum ney ( apney ameer ka ) kehna nahi maana   tum mein say kuch log woh thay jo duniya chahtay thay , aur kuch woh thay jo aakhirat chahtay thay phir Allah ney unn say tumhara rukh pher diya takay tumhen aazamaye . albatta abb woh tumhen moaaf ker-chuka hai , aur Allah mominon per bara fazal kernay wala hai .

. ( woh waqt yaad kero ) jab tum mun uthaye chalay jarahey thay aur kissi ko murr ker nahi dekhtay thay , aur Rasool tumharay peechay say tumhen pukar rahey thay , chunacheh Allah ney tumhen ( Rasool ko ) ghum ( denay ) kay badlay ( shikast ka ) ghum diya , takay aaenda tum ziyada sadma naa kiya kero ,   naa uss cheez per jo tumharay haath say jati rahey , aur naa kissi aur museebat per jo tumhen phonch jaye . aur Allah tumharay tamam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

phir uss ghum kay baad Allah ney tum per tamaniyat nazil ki , aik oongh jo tum mein say kuch logon  per chah rahi thi !   aur aik giroh woh tha jissay apni janon ki parri hoi thi . woh log Allah kay baaray mein nahaq aesay gumaan ker rahey thay jo jihalat kay khayalaat thay . woh keh rahey thay :  kiya hamen bhi koi ikhtiyar hasil hai-?  keh do kay :  ikhtiyar to tamam tarr Allah ka hai .  yeh log apney dilon mein woh baaten chupatay hain jo aap kay samney zahir nahi kertay .   kehtay hain kay agar hamen bhi kuch ikhtiyar hota to hum yahan qatal naa hotay .  keh do kay :  agar tum apney gharon mein hotay tab bhi jinn ka qatal hona muqaddar mein likha ja-chuka tha woh khud bahir nikal ker apni apni qatal gaahon tak phonch jatay . aur yeh sabb iss liye huwa takay jo kuch tumharay seenon mein hai Allah ussay aazamaye , aur jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai uss ka mail kuchail door kerday .   Allah dilon kay bhed ko khoob janta hai .

tum mein say jinn logon  ney uss din peeth pheri jab dono lashkar aik doosray say takraye , dar-haqeeqat unn kay baaz aemal kay nateejay mein shetan ney unn ko laghzish mein mubtala kerdiya tha .   aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah ney unhen moaaf kerdiya hai . yaqeenan Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara burdbaar hai .

aey emaan walo unn logon  ki tarah naa hojana jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , aur jab unn kay bhai kissi sarzameen mein safar kertay hain ya jang mein shamil hotay hain to yeh unn kay baaray mein kehtay hain kay :  agar woh humaray paas hotay to naa martay , aur naa maaray jatay .  ( inn ki iss baat ka ) nateeja to ( sirf ) yeh hai kay Allah aesi baaton ko unn kay dilon mein hasrat ka sabab bana deta hai , ( werna ) zindagi aur moat to Allah deta hai . aur jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah ussay dekh raha hai .
aur agar tum Allah kay raastay mein qatal hojao ya mar-jao , tab bhi Allah ki taraf say milney wali maghfirat aur rehmat unn cheezon say kahen behtar hai jo yeh log jama ker rahey hain .
aur agar tum mar-jao ya qatal hojao to Allah hi kay paas to ley jaker ikatthay kiye jao gay !

inn waqiyaat kay baad Allah ki rehmat hi thi jiss ki bana per ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ney inn logon  say narmi ka bartao kiya . agar tum sakht mizaj aur sakht dil walay hotay to yeh tumharay aas paas say hatt ker tittar-bittar hojatay . lehaza inn ko moaaf kerdo , inn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kero , aur inn say ( aham ) moamlaat mein mashwara letay raho . phir jab tum raye pukhta ker kay kissi baat ka azam kerlo to Allah per bharosa kero . Allah yaqeenan tawakkul kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

agar Allah tumhari madad keray to koi tum per ghalib aaney wala nahi , aur agar woh tumhen tanha chorr dey to kon hai jo uss kay baad tumhari madad keray-? aur mominon ko chahiye kay woh Allah hi per bharosa rakhen .

aur kissi nabi say yeh nahi hosakta kay woh maal-e-ghaneemat mein khayanat keray ,   aur jo koi khayanat keray ga woh qayamat kay din woh cheez ley ker aaye ga jo uss ney khayanat ker kay li hogi , phir her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur kissi per koi zulm nahi hoga .
bhala jo shaks Allah ki khushnoodi ka tabey ho woh uss shaks ki tarah hosakta hai jo Allah ki taraf say narazi ley ker loata ho , aur jiss ka thikana jahannum ho-? aur woh boht bura thikana hai !
Allah kay nazdeek inn logon  kay darjaat mukhtalif hain , aur jo kuch yeh kertay hain Allah uss ko khoob dekhta hai .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney mominon per bara ehsan kiya kay unn kay darmiyan unhi mein say aik Rasool bheja jo unn kay samney Allah ki aayaton ki tilawat keray , unhen pak saaf banaye aur unhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem dey , jabkay yeh log iss say pehlay yaqeenan khuli gumrahi mein mubtala thay .

jab tumhen aik aesi museebat phonchi jiss say dugni tum ( dushman ko ) phoncha chukay thay   to kiya tum aesay moaqa per yeh kehtay ho kay  yeh museebat kahan say aagae-?  keh do kay :  yeh khud tumhari taraf say aai hai .  beyshak Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
aur tumhen jo museebat uss din phonchi jab dono lashkar takraye thay , woh Allah kay hukum say phonchi , takay woh mominon ko bhi parakh ker dekh ley .

aur munafqeen ko bhi dekh ley . aur unn ( munafiqon ) say kaha gaya tha kay  aao Allah kay raastay mein jang kero ya difaa kero  to unhon ney kaha tha kay :  agar hum dekhtay kay ( jang ki tarah ) jang hogi to hum zaroor aap kay peechay chaltay .    uss din ( jab woh yeh baat keh rahey thay ) woh emaan ki ba nisbat kufr say ziyada qareeb thay . woh apney mun say woh baat kehtay hain jo unn kay dilon mein nahi hoti .   aur jo kuch yeh chupatay hain Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

yeh woh log hain jo apney ( shaheed ) bhaiyon kay baaray mein bethay bethay yeh baaten banatay hain kay agar woh humari baat mantay to qatal naa hotay . keh do kay :  agar tum sachay ho to khud apney aap hi say moat ko taal dena .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal huye hain , unhen hergiz murda naa samajhna , balkay woh zinda hain , unhen apney rab kay paas rizq milta hai .

Allah ney unn ko apney fazal say jo kuch diya hai woh uss per magan hain , aur unn kay peechay jo log abhi unn kay sath ( shahadat mein ) shamil nahi huye , unn kay baaray mein iss baat per bhi khushi manatay hain kay ( jab woh inn say aa-ker milen gay to ) naa unn per koi khof hoga aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
woh Allah ki naimat aur fazal per bhi khushi manatay hain aur iss baat per bhi kay Allah mominon ka ajar zaya nahi kerta .
woh log jinhon ney zakham khaney kay baad bhi Allah aur Rasool ki pukar ka farmanbardaari say jawab diya , aesay naik aur muttaqi logon  kay liye zabardast ajar hai .

woh log jinn say kehney walon ney kaha tha kay :  yeh ( makkah kay kafir ) log tumharay ( muqablay ) kay liye ( phir say ) jama hogaye hain , lehaza inn say dartay rehna . to iss ( khabar ) ney unn kay emaan mein aur izafa kerdiya aur woh bol uthay kay :  humaray liye Allah kafi hai aur woh behtareen kaarsaz hai .

nateeja yeh kay yeh log Allah ki naimat aur fazal ley ker iss tarah wapis aaye kay enhen zara bhi gazand nahi phonchi , aur woh Allah ki khushnoodi kay tabey rahey . aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .
dar-haqeeqat yeh to shetan hai jo apney doston say darata hai , lehaza agar tum momin ho to unn say khof naa khao , aur bus mera khof rakho .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log kufr mein aik doosray say barh ker tezi dikha rahey hain , woh tumhen sadmay mein naa daalen . yaqeen rakho woh Allah ka zara bhi nuqsan nahi ker-saktay . Allah yeh chahta hai kay aakhirat mein inn ka koi hissa naa rakhay , aur inn kay liye zabardast azab ( tayyar ) hai
jinn logon  ney emaan kay badlay kufr ko mol ley liya hai woh Allah ko hergiz zara bhi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay , aur unn kay liye aik dukh denay wala azab ( tayyar ) hai

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh hergiz yeh naa samjhen kay hum unhen jo dheel dey rahey hain woh unn kay liye koi achi baat hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum to unhen sirf iss liye dheel dey rahey hain takay woh gunah mein aur aagay barh jayen , aur ( aakhir kaar ) unn kay liye aisa azab hoga jo unhen zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

Allah aisa nahi ker-sakta kay mominon ko uss halat per chorray rakhay jiss per tum log iss waqt ho , jab tak woh napak ko pak say alag naa kerday , aur ( doosri taraf ) woh aisa bhi nahi ker-sakta kay tum ko ( barah-e-raast ) ghaib ki baaten bata dey . haan ! woh ( jitna batana munasib samajhta hai uss kay liye ) apney payghumberon mein say jiss ko chahta hai chunn leta hai .   lehaza tum Allah aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan rakho . aur agar emaan rakho gay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero gay to zabardast sawab kay mustahiq hogay .

aur jo log iss ( maal ) mein bukhul say kaam letay hain jo enhen Allah ney apney fazal say ata farmaya hai woh hergiz yeh naa samjhen kay yeh unn kay liye koi achi baat hai . iss kay bar-aks yeh unn kay haq mein boht buri baat hai . jiss maal mein unhon ney bukhul say kaam liya hoga , qayamat kay din woh unn kay galay ka toq bana diya jaye ga .   aur saray aasman aur zameen ki meeras sirf Allah hi kay liye hai , aur jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

Allah ney unn logon  ki baat sunn li hai jo yeh kehtay hain kay :  Allah faqeer hai aur hum maal daar hain .    hum unn ki yeh baat bhi ( unn kay aemal namay mein ) likhay letay hain , aur unhon ney anbiya ko jo nahaq qatal kiya hai , uss ko bhi , aur ( phir ) kahen gay kay :  dehakti aag ka maza chakho .
yeh sabb tumharay haathon kay kartoot ka nateeja hai jo tum ney aagay bhej rakha tha , werna Allah bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .

yeh woh log hain jo kehtay hain kay :  Allah ney hum say yeh wada liya hai kay kissi payghumber per uss waqt tak emaan naa layen jab tak woh humaray paas aesi qurbani ley ker naa aaye jissay aag kha jaye .    tum kaho kay :  mujh say pehlay tumharay paas boht say payghumber khuli nishaniyan bhi ley ker aaye aur woh cheez bhi jiss kay baaray mein tum ney ( mujh say ) kaha hai . phir tum ney unhen kiyon qatal kiya agar tum waqaee sachay ho-?

. ( aey payghumber ! ) agar phir bhi yeh log tumhen jhutlayen to ( yeh koi naee baat nahi ) tum say pehlay bhi boht say unn Rasoolon ko jhutlaya ja-chuka hai jo khuli khuli nishaniyan bhi laye thay , likhay huye saheefay bhi aur aesi kitab bhi jo ( haq ko ) roshan ker-denay wali thi .

her jandaar ko moat ka maza chakhna hai , aur tum sabb ko ( tumharay aemal kay ) pooray pooray badlay qayamat hi kay din milen gay . phir jiss kissi ko dozakh say door hata-liya gaya aur jannat mein dakhil kerdiya gaya , woh sahih maani mein kamiyab hogaya , aur yeh dunyawi zindagi to ( jannat kay muqablay mein ) dhokay kay saman kay siwa kuch bhi nahi .

. ( musalmano ! ) tumhen apney maal o dolat aur janon kay moamlay mein ( aur ) aazmaya jaye ga , aur tum ehal-e-kitab aur mushrikeen dono say boht si takleef deh baaten suno gay . aur agar tum ney sabar aur taqwa say kaam liya to yaqeenan yehi kaam bari himmat kay hain ( jo tumhen ikhtiyar kernay hain )

aur ( unn logon  ko woh waqt naa bhoolna chahiye ) jab Allah ney ehal-e-kitab say yeh ehad liya tha kay :  tum iss kitab ko logon  kay samney zaroor khol khol ker biyan kero gay , aur iss ko chupao gay nahi .  phir unhon ney uss ehad ko pus-e-pusht daal diya aur uss kay badlay thori si qeemat hasil kerli . iss tarah kitni buri hai woh cheez jo yeh mol ley rahey hain . !

yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jo log apney kiye per baray khush hain , aur chahtay hain kay unn ki tareef unn kamon per bhi ki jaye jo unhon ney kiye hi nahi , aesay logon  kay baaray mein hergiz yeh naa samajhna kay woh azab say bachney mein kamiyab hojayen gay . unn kay liye dardnak saza ( tayyar ) hai .
aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat sirf Allah ki hai , aur Allah her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai .
beyshak aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq mein aur raat din kay baari baari aaney janey mein unn aqal walon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .

jo uthtay bethtay aur letay huye ( her haal mein ) Allah ko yaad kertay hain , aur aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq per ghor kertay hain , ( aur unhen dekh ker bol uthtay hain kay )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney yeh sabb kuch bey maqsad peda nahi kiya . aap ( aesay fuzool kaam say ) pak hain . pus hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha lijiye .
aey humaray rab ! aap jiss kissi ko dozakh mein dakhil kerden , ussay aap ney yaqeenan ruswa hi kerdiya . aur zalimon ko kissi qisam kay madadgaar naseeb naa hon gay .

aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum ney aik munadi ko suna jo emaan ki taraf pukar raha tha kay  apney perwerdigar per emaan lao  chunacheh hum emaan ley aaye . lehaza aey humaray perwerdigar ! humari khatir humaray gunah bakhsh dijiye , humari buraiyon ko hum say mita dijiye , aur hamen naik logon  mein shamil ker kay apney paas bulaiye

aur aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen woh kuch bhi ata farmaiye jiss ka wada aap ney apney payghumberon kay zariye hum say kiya hai , aur hamen qayamat kay din ruswa naa kijiye . yaqeenan aap waday ki kabhi khilaf warzi nahi kiya kertay .

chunacheh unn kay perwerdigar ney unn ki dua qubool ki ( aur kaha ) kay :  mein tum mein say kissi ka amal zaya nahi kerun ga , khuwa woh mard ho ya aurat . tum sabb aapas mein aik jaisay ho . lehaza jinn logon  ney hijrat ki , aur unhen unn kay gharon say nikala gaya , aur meray raastay mein takleefen di gaeen , aur jinhon ney ( deen ki khatir ) larraee larri aur qatal huye , mein unn sabb ki buraiyon ka zaroor kaffara kerdun ga , aur unhen zaroor bil-zaroor aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kerun ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi ; yeh sabb kuch Allah ki taraf say inaam hoga , aur Allah hi hai jiss kay paas behtareen inaam hai
jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai unn ka shehron mein ( khushhali kay sath ) chalna phirna tumhen hergiz dhokay mein naa daalay .
yeh to thora saa maza hai ( jo yeh urra rahey hain ) phir inn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh bad-tareen bichona hai

lekin jo log apney perwerdigar say dartay huye amal kertay hain , unn kay liye aesay baaghaat hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , Allah ki taraf say meyzbani kay tor per woh hamesha unn mein rahen gay . aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai woh naik logon  kay liye kahen behtar hai

aur beyshak ehal-e-kitab mein bhi aesay log mojood hain jo Allah kay aagay ijz o niaz ka muzahira kertay huye Allah per bhi emaan rakhtay hain , uss kitab per bhi jo tum per nazil ki gaee hai aur uss per bhi jo unn per nazil ki gaee thi , aur Allah ki aayaton ko thori si qeemat ley ker bech nahi daaltay . yeh woh log hain jo apney perwerdigar kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hain . beyshak Allah hisab jald chukaney wala hai .
aey emaan walo ! sabar ikhtiyar kero , muqablay kay waqt sabit qadmi dikhao , aur sarhadon ki hifazat kay liye jamay raho .   aur Allah say dartay raho , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .
